SocialActions.Name: Enable Social Actions

SubterfugeActions.Name: Enable Subterfuge Actions
SubterfugeActions.Hint: Enable Skillful Consequences cards for supported Stealth and Thievery actions when this pack contains cards.

PhysicalActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Physical Actions
PhysicalActions.Description: Action-specific critical successes and critical failures for Athletics and Acrobatics. The normal PF2e result is always resolved first.

SocialActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Social Actions
SocialActions.Description: Reserved for action-specific consequences for Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance.

SubterfugeActions.Title: Skillful Consequences: Subterfuge Actions
SubterfugeActions.Description: Reserved for action-specific consequences for Stealth and Thievery.

KnowledgeUtility.Title: Skillful Consequences: Knowledge & Utility
KnowledgeUtility.Description: Reserved for knowledge, medicine, crafting, survival, and other utility actions.

ReadTheStruggle.Title: Read the Struggle
ReadTheStruggle.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. If the same target Escapes before the end of your next turn, your next Grapple check against that target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

LockedInLeverage.Title: Locked-In Leverage
LockedInLeverage.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts by that target to Shove, Reposition, or Trip you.

OpeningForTheTeam.Title: Opening for the Team
OpeningForTheTeam.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Grapple first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

OvercommittedHold.Title: Overcommitted Hold
OvercommittedHold.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. Your next Athletics check before the end of your next turn takes a -1 circumstance penalty. The penalty then ends.

BreathLostInTheClinch.Title: Breath Lost in the Clinch
BreathLostInTheClinch.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. The failed clinch leaves you committed for a heartbeat; you can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

TechniqueLaidBare.Title: Technique Laid Bare
TechniqueLaidBare.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Grapple first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and anyone closely observing the exchange can clearly see how you tried to enter the hold and where your leverage failed.

CleanFollowThrough.Title: Clean Follow-Through
CleanFollowThrough.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. You may immediately Step up to 5 feet as a free action, but you must end this Step adjacent to the target.

GroundedAdvantage.Title: Grounded Advantage
GroundedAdvantage.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. Your next Grapple or Reposition check against the same target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

FootworkIntact.Title: Footwork Intact
FootworkIntact.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Trip first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts to Trip or Reposition you.

StanceCollapses.Title: Stance Collapses
StanceCollapses.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. Until the start of your next turn, you take a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves and Reflex DC.

RecoveryOutOfSequence.Title: Recovery Out of Sequence
RecoveryOutOfSequence.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. If you Stand before the end of your next turn, your Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of the turn in which you Stand. If you don't Stand before then, this consequence ends with no additional effect.

SetupTelegraphsItself.Title: Setup Telegraphs Itself
SetupTelegraphsItself.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Trip first. There is no additional mechanical effect. Anyone closely watching the exchange can tell exactly how you tried to take the target's footing and where the setup became obvious.

MomentumCarries.Title: Momentum Carries
MomentumCarries.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Shove first. The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn as it recovers from the forced movement.

BrokenLine.Title: Broken Line
BrokenLine.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Shove first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Grapple, Reposition, or Trip the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

OpenToCounterforce.Title: Open to Counterforce
OpenToCounterforce.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Shove first. The first creature that attempts to Shove or Reposition you before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

CommittedDirection.Title: Committed Direction
CommittedDirection.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Shove first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and nearby observers can plainly read the direction of force you committed to and where your push lost its line.

ControlledRotation.Title: Controlled Rotation
ControlledRotation.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Reposition first. The first ally other than you who attempts to Trip or Disarm the same target before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

BaseKeptUnderYou.Title: Base Kept Under You
BaseKeptUnderYou.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Reposition first. Until the start of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC against attempts by that target to Reposition, Shove, or Trip you.

FeetCrossed.Title: Feet Crossed
FeetCrossed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Reposition first. Your Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of your next turn while you recover your stance.

IntendedPathRevealed.Title: Intended Path Revealed
IntendedPathRevealed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Reposition first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and close observers can tell exactly where you meant to put the target and which piece of leverage failed.

SentClear.Title: Sent Clear
SentClear.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Disarm first. If the target drops the item because of that result, you may choose an unoccupied legal space adjacent to the target for the item to land in. If no such space is available, it lands normally.

HandsFreeToFollow.Title: Hands Free to Follow
HandsFreeToFollow.Description: Resolve the normal critical success for Disarm first. Your next Grapple or Shove check against the same target before the end of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus. The bonus then ends.

GripOpenedInstead.Title: Grip Opened Instead
GripOpenedInstead.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Disarm first. The first creature that attempts to Disarm you before the start of your next turn gains a +1 circumstance bonus to that check. The bonus then ends.

IntentTelegraphed.Title: Intent Telegraphed
IntentTelegraphed.Description: Resolve the normal critical failure for Disarm first. There is no additional mechanical effect. The target and anyone watching closely can see which item, hand, or grip you were trying to attack and how you meant to strip it away.
